  "memo_markdown": "Merchant 34 triggered AUP-06.1 on April 23: three disputes across 114 trailing-30-day orders, a 2.63% chargeback rate. GMV was 5,851,546 cents. Validate dispute uniqueness and denominator completeness, and reconcile the daily and trailing dispute counts by reporting scope.\n\nRepeated non-delivery combined with concentrated thin-account purchases and settlement extraction would support bust-out and justify considering a settlement pause. Verified fulfillment, resolved disputes, documented campaign attribution or a corrected data error removing the breach would weaken the alert. Current evidence does not support irreversible offboarding. A human owns the action."
